description: Matches two sheets deterministically and returns counts and samples of matched (exactly one candidate), left-only, right-only and ambiguous (several candidates) rows. Conditions: equal columns, and for rows without a shared key (free-text reports, nicknames) contains, dateWithin, rewrite, targetFilter and group. You write the rules; the matching runs in the work screen. Try the rules here and show the counts and samples before writing anything with apply_rule lookup (same conditions). Use it, for example, to investigate TAGNO mismatches.

contains.description: The text on this side contains the other side's name (both after normalize and rewrite; names shorter than 2 characters are not used)

col.description: Free-text column on this (left) side, e.g. the work done

targetCol.description: Name column on the other side. With via, the column whose value is looked up in another sheet

via.description: Take the name from another sheet, e.g. {sheet:"Assets",matchCol:"ASSETNUM",sourceCol:"DESCRIPTION"} for a work order's ASSETNUM

dateWithin.description: The date on this side falls within the other side's start to end (by day, inclusive). Dates written as 2026-05-04, 2026/5/4 or in the Japanese era (R8.5.4), with or without the Japanese year, month and day marks, are read as they are; do not rewrite them

targetEnd.description: End date column on the other side, e.g. ACTFINISH. Blank: the start day only

targetStart.description: Start date column on the other side, e.g. ACTSTART

dictionaries.description: Customer dictionaries of names to apply first, to the text of this (left) side only (how the customer writes a name → the name in Maximo). Use the customer's dictionaries listed in get_status. Prefer adding entries to a dictionary over one-off rewrite rules, so the people can see and keep them

followsAbove.description: A row whose text matches pattern and that has no single match of its own takes the record of the row directly above, when that row matched one record

pattern.description: Regular expression for ditto rows (a ditto mark or word at the start of the text), tested on the text as written

group.description: Column on this side naming one document (e.g. a report number). Use it only when one document is about one record: if the rows that matched one record agree, every row of the document gets it; if they disagree, all its rows are ambiguous

leftCol.description: Match column(s) on the left sheet (equal values). Use an array for a composite key. May be omitted when contains or dateWithin is given

leftFilter.description: Narrow the left side (the same rows you will give apply_rule as filter)

attr.description: Attribute or column name. Join child attributes with a dot, e.g. EXT_WOPERMIT.EXT_PERMITDATE

rewrite.description: Rules that make nicknames and variant spellings the same, applied in order to the text of both sides after normalize (write them for the normalized text). Example: [{find:"#(\d)",replace:"UNIT $1"}]. Keep each rule narrow

rightCol.description: Match column(s) on the right sheet (same order and count as leftCol)

targetFilter.description: Narrow the other side, e.g. WORKTYPE in CM,EM for repair rows

attr.description: Attribute or column name. Join child attributes with a dot, e.g. EXT_WOPERMIT.EXT_PERMITDATE

name: match_sheets
